title: Monomial expansion of the inner product bit
statement: For every natural number $n$, the inner product modulo two on a pair of Boolean-coordinate vectors of length $n$ is the sum over $i<n$ of the monomial given by the product of the two coordinates in position $i$, with the sum and products taken in $\mathbb F_2$.
